name: pass
_comment: Happy path: Codex (Architect) drafts; the Claude Developer review (arch.dev_review) returns FEASIBLE -> the Tech-Lead CONTROL gate (arch.tech_lead) returns READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW -> PASS. Arbiter not invoked (no deadlock). ARCH-02 (2026-08-31): this is ALSO the zero-audit contract — the Developer returns FEASIBLE on the first draft, so no repeat assessment is eligible and `arch.semantic_repeat` is never called. It carries no scripted response for that step on purpose: if the ordinary path ever started paying for an audit, this fixture would have to be changed to keep passing.
